name: CastSponsorSkip
description: A Go program that skips sponsored YouTube content and skippable ads on all local Google Cast devices, using the SponsorBlock API.

variables.name: Categories
variables.description: Comma-separated list of SponsorBlock categories to skip. See: https://wiki.sponsor.ajay.app/w/Types#Category

variables.name: YouTube API Key
variables.description: YouTube API key for fallback video identification (required on some Chromecast devices).

variables.name: Mute Ads
variables.description: Mutes the device while an ad is playing.

variables.name: Skip Sponsors
variables.description: Toggles sponsored segment skipping via the SponsorBlock API. If disabled, only YouTube ads will be skipped.

variables.name: Discover Interval
variables.description: Interval to restart the DNS discovery client.

variables.name: Paused Interval
variables.description: Time to wait between each poll of the Cast device status when paused.

variables.name: Playing Interval
variables.description: Time to wait between each poll of the Cast device status when playing.

variables.name: Devices
variables.description: Comma-separated list of device addresses. This will disable discovery and is not recommended unless discovery fails.
